instructions.name: consumer_confirm
docs: Release escrow to the provider authority. Callable by the consumer
any time after ProviderDone, or by anyone after CONFIRM_WINDOW.
Closes the Job PDA; rent returns to consumer.

accounts.name: job
docs: Job being settled. Closed after settlement; rent → consumer.

accounts.name: provider
docs: Provider whose counters get incremented (`jobs_completed`, `total_earned`).
PDA re-derivation guarantees `provider.authority` matches the seed,
and the constraint binds it to the original Job.

accounts.name: consumer
docs: Rent recipient on close. Must equal `job.consumer`. May or may
not be the signer — when the signer is someone else (auto-release),
the consumer still gets the rent back.

accounts.name: provider_authority
docs: Payment recipient. Must equal `job.provider_authority` (snapshotted
at `create_job` so a Provider authority change after the fact does
not redirect funds).

accounts.name: signer
docs: Either the consumer (any time) or anyone (after CONFIRM_WINDOW).
The window check lives in the handler body.

instructions.name: create_job
docs: Create an escrowed inference job after verifying the provider's
Ed25519-signed quote (carried in a sibling instruction).

accounts.name: job
docs: New Job PDA. Seeded by `(consumer, nonce)` so the same consumer
can have multiple concurrent jobs without collision.

accounts.name: provider
docs: Provider being engaged. The seed constraint re-derives the PDA
from `provider.authority` and rejects any account that wasn't
genuinely created by `register_provider`.

accounts.name: consumer
docs: Consumer paying for the job. Funds the escrow and the Job PDA rent.

accounts.name: instructions
docs: Instructions sysvar — used to read the Ed25519Program sibling
instruction that carries the provider's signed quote.

instructions.name: provider_complete
docs: Provider submits the response_hash, transitioning Job from
Pending to ProviderDone and starting the auto-release window.

accounts.name: job
docs: Job to mark as ProviderDone. Must be in Pending state and bound
to the Provider account passed in. The seed constraint
re-derives the Job PDA from its stored consumer + nonce so a
caller cannot pass an arbitrary look-alike account.

accounts.name: provider
docs: Provider PDA, re-derived from `authority` so we know the signer
is the legitimate authority for THIS Provider record.

accounts.name: authority
docs: Provider authority — must sign and must match `job.provider_authority`.

instructions.name: refund_job
docs: Refund escrow to the consumer once JOB_TIMEOUT has elapsed and
the provider has not delivered. Closes the Job PDA.

accounts.name: job
docs: Job to refund. `has_one = consumer` enforces the signer is the
original consumer; only the original consumer can refund.
State and timeout checks live in the handler body to provide
granular error variants.

accounts.name: consumer
docs: Original consumer. Receives both the escrowed `amount` (drained
manually below) and the rent-exempt minimum (via Anchor close).

instructions.name: register_provider
docs: Register a new AI inference provider.
One provider per authority wallet (PDA seeded by authority).

accounts.name: provider
docs: New Provider PDA, seeded by the authority pubkey. Anchor's `init`
constraint enforces single-registration per authority — a second
call with the same authority will fail with `AccountAlreadyInUse`.

accounts.name: authority
docs: Wallet registering the provider. Pays for account creation and
becomes the provider's controlling identity.

instructions.name: rotate_peer_id
docs: Rotate the provider's QVAC DHT peer ID.
Called when the provider restarts with a new Hyperswarm seed.

instructions.name: update_provider
docs: Update a provider's mutable fields (name, task_types).

accounts.name: provider
docs: Existing Provider PDA. `has_one` enforces that the signer matches
`provider.authority`. Version check rejects accounts created by a
future incompatible build.

types.name: Job
docs: Escrowed inference job.
Holds the consumer's payment in its own lamports balance until
`consumer_confirm` (releases to provider) or `refund_job` (returns
to consumer). Closed in either terminal path; rent returns to consumer.

fields.name: version
docs: Layout version. Must equal `JOB_VERSION`; otherwise reject.

fields.name: task_type
docs: `TaskType` discriminant (0..=`TaskType::MAX`). Validated against
`provider.task_types` bitmask at create time.

fields.name: consumer
docs: Consumer who funded the escrow. Sole valid refund destination
and rent recipient on close. PDA seed.

fields.name: provider
docs: Provider PDA bound to this job. Verified against the Provider
account passed to `provider_complete` and `consumer_confirm`.

fields.name: provider_authority
docs: Provider's payout wallet (= `provider.authority` at create time).
Snapshotted so that even if Provider is updated mid-job, payment
still goes to the originally agreed authority.

fields.name: request_hash
docs: SHA256(input_bytes || nonce.to_le_bytes()). Binds the job to a
specific off-chain payload. Provider verifies via bridge.js
before serving inference.

fields.name: response_hash
docs: SHA256 of the response. Zeros until `provider_complete` sets it.

fields.name: amount
docs: Lamports escrowed. Snapshot of the price agreed in the signed
quote — protects consumer from price changes mid-flight.

fields.name: payment_mint
docs: `Pubkey::default()` = native SOL (MVP).
Any other value = SPL mint (returns `PaymentMintMismatch` in MVP;
reserved field for V2 SPL implementation).

fields.name: nonce
docs: Consumer-supplied uniqueness seed. PDA seed; allows multiple
concurrent jobs from the same consumer.

fields.name: created_at
docs: Unix timestamp at `create_job`. Refund eligible once
`now >= created_at + JOB_TIMEOUT`.

fields.name: provider_done_at
docs: Unix timestamp at `provider_complete`. Auto-release eligible once
`now >= provider_done_at + CONFIRM_WINDOW`. Zero until set.

fields.name: state
docs: Lifecycle state. See `JobState`.

fields.name: bump
docs: Cached PDA bump.

fields.name: reserved
docs: Reserved bytes for forward compatibility. Planned use:
token_count (4) | consumer_rating (1) | dispute_reason (1) |
response_ms (4) | spare (21).

types.name: JobState
docs: Job lifecycle. Stored as a single byte on-chain.

types.name: Provider
docs: Registered AI inference provider.
One Provider per wallet (authority). The PDA is derived from the
authority pubkey, which doubles as the provider's identity in the
marketplace. `qvac_peer_id` is the Hyperdht public key consumers
connect to via `dht.connect(publicKey)` — required because the QVAC
SDK is key-based, not topic-based.

fields.name: version
docs: Layout version. Must equal `PROVIDER_VERSION`; otherwise reject.

fields.name: task_types
docs: Bitmask of supported `TaskType` values: `1u16 << (TaskType as u8)`.
Must be non-zero. Bit N set means task_type N is supported.

fields.name: authority
docs: Wallet that registered and controls this provider. Also the
destination for completed-job payouts. PDA seed.

fields.name: qvac_peer_id
docs: Hyperdht public key (Ed25519, 32 bytes). Consumers use this with
the QVAC SDK as `loadModel({ delegate: { providerPublicKey } })`.
Updatable via the V2 `update_provider_peer_id` ix when the
provider's `QVAC_HYPERSWARM_SEED` rotates.

fields.name: name
docs: Display name. Validated to 3..=50 UTF-8 bytes at write time.

fields.name: jobs_completed
docs: Lifetime count of jobs successfully completed and paid out.

fields.name: jobs_disputed
docs: Lifetime count of jobs that ended in dispute (V2; unused in MVP).

fields.name: total_earned
docs: Lifetime lamports earned across all completed jobs. `checked_add` only.

fields.name: registered_at
docs: Unix timestamp at `register_provider`.

fields.name: bump
docs: Cached PDA bump for cheap re-derivation in subsequent ixs.

fields.name: reserved
docs: Reserved bytes for forward compatibility. Planned use:
stake_amount (8) | reputation_score (8) | last_active_at (8) |
tier (1) | is_verified (1) | spare (4).
